name: Viego
title: The Ruined King

Q.name: Blade of the Ruined King
Q.description: Passive: Viego's Attacks deal an additional (2/3/4/5/6) × 0.01 current Health physical damage. His first Attack against an enemy he has recently damaged with an Ability hits a second time, dealing 0.2×AD + 0.15×AP physical damage and restoring 150% of damage dealt as Health. These bonuses are kept during Possession. Active: Viego stabs forward, dealing (25/40/55/70/85 + 0.7×AD) × (1 + (0.6×crit × (1×stat + -1))) physical damage.
Q.summary: Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health. Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.

W.name: Spectral Maw
W.description: Begin Charging: Viego begins gathering Mist, Slowing himself by 10%. Release: Viego dashes forward and hurls the gathered Mist. Deals 80/135/190/245/300 + 1×AP magic damage and Stuns the first enemy hit for 0.25 to 1.25 seconds based on charge time.
W.summary: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.

E.name: Harrowed Path
E.description: Viego sends forth a spectre to haunt the first terrain hit, surrounding it with Mist for 8 seconds. Viego gains Camouflage, (varies) Move Speed, and 30/35/40/45/50% Attack Speed while inside the Mist.
E.summary: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.

R.name: Heartbreaker
R.description: Viego discards any souls he is currently Possessing and teleports. On arrival he Attacks the champion with the lowest percent Health, briefly Slowing them by 99% and dealing (1.2×AD) × (1 + (0.7×crit × (1×stat + -1))) + 12/16/20 + 0.05×bonus AD% missing Health physical damage. Other nearby enemies are Knocked Back and take (1.2×AD) × (1 + (0.7×crit × (1×stat + -1))) physical damage.
R.summary: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.

Passive.name: Sovereign's Domination
Passive.description: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.
Passive.summary: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Skirmishing jungler who resets fights by possessing dead enemies through his passive. Wins by entering fights after a takedown and chaining kills with R.
strengths: Passive possession heals him and gives a new body and its basic abilities after each takedown
Q passive deals % current health damage on attacks
W charge stuns up to 1.25 s and dashes
E camouflage zone gives attack speed and stealth for ganks
R teleport and execute on the lowest-health target restarts fights
weaknesses: Snowball-dependent; weak if fights don't produce takedowns
W stun is a skillshot charge that can be dodged
Weak to crowd control chains while he's going in
Possessed bodies keep the target's weaknesses

curve.lvl3: strong – full clear and gank with W stun
curve.items: strong – Blade of the Ruined King / Kraken

profile.curveNote: Wants Q, W and E for clear and ganks; possession needs takedowns.
profile.mobility: medium – W dash, R teleport, E camouflage

Passive.notes: Attacking a wraith possesses the dead champion, healing him and using their basic abilities.

Q.notes: Passive % current-health damage on attacks; active stab; double-hit after an ability.

W.notes: Charge 0.25–1.25 s stun; dashes forward on release.

E.notes: Mist around terrain: camouflage, move speed, attack speed.

R.notes: Teleports and strikes the lowest-% health champion; area damage; resets possession.

profile.windowAgainst: W on cooldown and no wraiths nearby: he has no stun and no reset. Before level 3.
